scenarios.title: A｜确认遗失
scenarios.setting: 旅行途中，玩家回到酒店后发现护照不见了。玩家先联系最后去过的餐厅。

turns.text: Hello, how can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi. I think I may have left my passport at your restaurant.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I think I may have left my passport at your restaurant.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I’m calling because I can’t find my passport. I was there earlier today.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling because I can’t find my passport. I was there earlier today.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Has anyone turned in a passport today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has anyone turned in a passport today?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I was sitting near the window around lunchtime. Could you check if a passport was found there?

feedback.naturalExpression: I was sitting near the window around lunchtime. Could you check if a passport was found there?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I forgot my passport in your restaurant.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. I think I may have left my passport at your restaurant.
feedback.explanation: 东西遗落用“left”；地点尚不确定时加“may have”，准确表达可能落在餐厅。

turns.text: I’ll check our lost and found. Can you describe it?

turns.prompt: 对方需要辨认物品，你会怎样描述特征？

choices.text: It’s a Chinese passport with a dark red cover.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a Chinese passport with a dark red cover.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: It’s in a small black travel wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s in a small black travel wallet.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: My name is Alex Chen. It should be inside a blue passport holder.

feedback.naturalExpression: My name is Alex Chen. It should be inside a blue passport holder.
feedback.explanation: “my name is”在登记时直接报出姓名，方便对方查找记录。

turns.text: I’m sorry, but nothing matching that description has been turned in.

turns.prompt: 你想请对方继续留意遗失物品，并商量后续联系，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you take my number in case someone turns it in later?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you take my number in case someone turns it in later?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you check around the table where I was sitting?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check around the table where I was sitting?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll contact the other places I visited today.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll contact the other places I visited today.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜向警方报案
scenarios.setting: 确认几个地点都没有找到后，玩家到警察局报失。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d like to report a lost passport.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report a lost passport.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’ve lost my passport and need to file a report.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my passport and need to file a report.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I think my passport may have been stolen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think my passport may have been stolen.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I can’t find my passport, and I’m supposed to fly home in three days.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t find my passport, and I’m supposed to fly home in three days.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I want to report my passport disappeared.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report a lost passport.
feedback.explanation: “report”后需完整连接内容；“report a lost passport”能直接说明要报失护照。

turns.text: When did you last see it?

turns.prompt: 关于「护照遗失」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I last saw it at my hotel this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I last saw it at my hotel this morning.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

choices.text: I had it with me when I checked in yesterday.

feedback.naturalExpression: I had it with me when I checked in yesterday.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I’m not completely sure. I noticed it was missing this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not completely sure. I noticed it was missing this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

choices.text: I may have lost it somewhere between the restaurant and the train station.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have lost it somewhere between the restaurant and the train station.
feedback.explanation: “may have lost”表达对过去情况的推测，避免把尚未确定的遗失地点说死。

turns.text: Do you have a copy or photo of your passport?

turns.prompt: 关于「护照遗失」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. I have a photo of it on my phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have a photo of it on my phone.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I have a photocopy in my luggage.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a photocopy in my luggage.
feedback.explanation: “luggage”指行李的统称，通常不可数；数量可用“pieces of luggage”。

choices.text: No, but I know my passport number.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, but I know my passport number.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: Unfortunately, I don’t have a copy.

feedback.naturalExpression: Unfortunately, I don’t have a copy.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.text: We’ll give you a copy of the police report.

turns.prompt: 你想确认办理补证时是否需要这份材料，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will I need this when I contact my embassy?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I need this when I contact my embassy?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Is there a report number I should keep?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a report number I should keep?
feedback.explanation: “report number”指报告或报案编号，便于后续联系时定位记录。

choices.text: What should I do if someone finds the passport later?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do if someone finds the passport later?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

scenarios.title: C｜寻求补办帮助
scenarios.setting: 玩家拿着报案材料联系使领馆，询问如何继续旅行。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve lost my passport and need help getting a replacement.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my passport and need help getting a replacement.
feedback.explanation: “a replacement”指替换品，区别于直接退款或继续等待维修。

choices.text: My passport is missing, and I have a flight home in three days.

feedback.naturalExpression: My passport is missing, and I have a flight home in three days.
feedback.explanation: “is missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: I’ve already reported the loss to the police. What should I do next?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve already reported the loss to the police. What should I do next?
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

choices.text: I need an emergency travel document. Could you tell me how to apply for one?

feedback.naturalExpression: I need an emergency travel document. Could you tell me how to apply for one?
feedback.explanation: “emergency”指紧急情况，表明需要及时处理。

choices.text: I need to make a new passport immediately.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my passport and need help getting a replacement.
feedback.explanation: 补办护照用“apply for / get a replacement passport”；“make”像自己制作一本。

turns.text: Do you have the police report and another form of identification?

turns.prompt: 关于「护照遗失」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes. I have the police report and my driver’s license.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I have the police report and my driver’s license.
feedback.explanation: “driver’s license”是驾驶执照，说明失物中的证件有助于辨认身份。

choices.text: I have the report, but my other ID was in my wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have the report, but my other ID was in my wallet.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I have digital copies of some of my documents. Will those help?

feedback.naturalExpression: I have digital copies of some of my documents. Will those help?
feedback.explanation: “copies”指副本或复印件，用于确认材料形式。

turns.text: We’ll explain what documents you’ll need and what options are available.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long does the process usually take?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long does the process usually take?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Will I still be able to take my flight in three days?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will I still be able to take my flight in three days?
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Do I need to make an appointment?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to make an appointment?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Is there anything I should prepare before I come in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I should prepare before I come in?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。
